data.description: Delivered 20+ production features for OPERA Cloud used by 40K+ hotels globally, including reusable UI components and page-template frameworks across 8+ modules. Built REST APIs in a microservices architecture, improved response times by ~15%, and contributed to cross-region localization. Applied SOLID design patterns, mentored interns, and built Python + LLM internal workflows that reduced manual effort by ~30%.

Built full-stack features with React, TypeScript, Java, and REST APIs for Oracle Hospitality products. Improved UI latency by ~20%, developed Java/Spring microservices for high-concurrency scenarios, and optimized SQL queries and state management to improve data retrieval performance by ~25%. Contributed to CI/CD and code-review practices that reduced defects and improved deployment stability.

Audited 10+ microservices and supported bulk dependency/version upgrades for stable deployments. Assisted feature development, integration, and debugging in a distributed service ecosystem. Built Cypress and Jest test coverage and automated Jira workflows using Python to improve team efficiency.

Developed browser-based video, audio, and PDF editor tools with 20+ features using FFmpeg (WASM) and PDF libraries. Optimized client-side processing for large file operations, reducing processing time by ~30% while improving UI responsiveness and data privacy through local-first processing.
